title: Native kept flagged and source preservation
rule: Every fixture feature is native, kept, or flagged, and each row is proven or unproven. Native features are real editable objects. Kept features stay byte-for-byte with their stored preview and are not claimed editable. Flagged features are preserved except for the security removals listed in this contract: external relationships that fetch remote content, macros, and active embedded objects. A change carries the parts it depends on. Uncompressed part bytes stay identical aside from those removals. Provenance records the source part hash. Migration of stored provenance is additive-only.
alternatives: Rewrite uncompressed parts to normalize XML.
